description: This file defines the TpmAttestationRecordContext class, which extends keymaster::AttestationContext, and the AttestationIds struct used for managing attestation-related data in the context of TPM attestation within the Android Open Source Project. It includes method declarations for generating and verifying device IDs, retrieving attestation keys and chains, and setting verified boot information.

classes.name: TpmAttestationRecordContext
classes.description: A class that provides TPM attestation context, including methods for security level retrieval, device ID verification, unique ID generation, and attestation info management.

classes.name: AttestationIds
classes.description: A struct holding various device identifiers such as brand, device, product, serial, IMEI, MEID, manufacturer, model, and second IMEI.

methods.name: GetSecurityLevel
methods.description: Returns the security level of the TPM attestation context.

methods.name: VerifyAndCopyDeviceIds
methods.description: Verifies and copies device IDs based on provided authorization sets.

methods.name: GenerateUniqueId
methods.description: Generates a unique identifier based on input parameters.

methods.name: GetAttestationKey
methods.description: Retrieves the attestation key blob for a specified algorithm.

methods.name: GetAttestationChain
methods.description: Retrieves the attestation certificate chain for a specified algorithm.

methods.name: SetVerifiedBootInfo
methods.description: Sets verified boot state, bootloader state, and digest.

methods.name: SetAttestationIds
methods.description: Sets device attestation IDs from a request.

methods.name: SetAttestationIdsKM3
methods.description: Sets device attestation IDs for KM3 from a request.
